data.summary: The Zentrales Mahngericht Hessen at Amtsgericht Beispielhünfeld issued a court payment order (Mahnbescheid) against Marlene Probstweiler on behalf of Zahnarztpraxis Dr. Exempelzahn, claiming a total of €666.68 for a dental bill of 2 June 2026 plus interest and procedural costs. The order was delivered on 20 November 2026 via letterbox drop, and she must pay or object (Widerspruch) within two weeks of delivery.
data.explanation: This is an official German court order, not a private dunning letter. The court has NOT checked whether the dental practice's claim is actually valid — it only forwarded the claim. You now have a choice: either pay the full amount to the creditor, or tell the court (in writing) that and to what extent you disagree (Widerspruch). The app will show the deadline computed from the delivery date. If you do neither, the creditor can ask the court for an enforcement order (Vollstreckungsbescheid), which allows forced debt collection. If you are unsure whether the claim is justified, filing an objection costs nothing extra at this stage and keeps your options open — consider getting legal advice if the amount or basis is disputed.
